extracted.name: 200 California Farm Tempura Chicken on Pine Apple
extracted.description: Tempura Battered Chicken pieces, on a bed of gingerfried Fresh pineapple cubes, tempura fried fresh garden vegetables on the side, makes a simple weekday summer meal taste special.
ingredient_lines: Half a young chicken cut in six pieces: 2 leg pieces, 2 breast pieces, 2 wing pieces
Tempura batter: 1/4 cup olive oil, 1/4 cup cornstarch, 1/4 cup water,1/2 cup all purpose flour, beaten egg, pepper, salt
1 carrot, cut in green bean length pieces, sliced in eights
Half a fresh pine apple, peeled and cubed in 1/2” cubes
instruction_lines: Make tempura batter, dip vegetable in batter, fry each veggie seperately in 350F degree grapeseed oil, five minutes on each side, keep warm in 250F degree oven on serving plate. This way the flavor of the fresh veggies transfers to the chicken through the oil.
Dip chicken pieces in batter. Fry one piece at a time, five minutes each side in 350F degree grapeseed oil, keep warm in 250F degree oven on serving plate.

Next, In large cast iron skillet, brown fresh gingerstrips and then add and sautee diced fresh pineapple in its juice till carmelized. When you can smell the ginger and pine apple turn sweet, about half an hour, transfer to serving platter.
Put carmelized pine apple ginger on bottom of serving platter, chicken on top, tempura veggies on the side, enjoy.
